# visualization.design_map.plot_sampling_frame { #fmrimod.visualization.design_map.plot_sampling_frame }

```python
plot_sampling_frame(
    sframe,
    style='timeline',
    show_ticks=True,
    tick_every=None,
    figsize=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Plot sampling frame structure.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                     | Description                                                                     | Default      |
|------------|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| sframe     | SamplingFrame or similar | Sampling frame to visualize                                                     | _required_   |
| style      | (\'timeline\', \'grid\') | 'timeline': horizontal bars per run 'grid': scan tiles showing timing structure | `'timeline'` |
| show_ticks | bool                     | Show tick marks                                                                 | `True`       |
| tick_every | float                    | Tick spacing in seconds                                                         | `None`       |
| figsize    | tuple                    | Figure size                                                                     | `None`       |
| **kwargs   | object                   | Additional arguments passed to plot functions                                   | `{}`         |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description       |
|--------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| fig    | matplotlib.figure.Figure | The figure object |
| ax     | matplotlib.axes.Axes     | The axes object   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Timeline view
>>> fig, ax = plot_sampling_frame(sframe, style='timeline')
>>>
>>> # Grid view
>>> fig, ax = plot_sampling_frame(sframe, style='grid')
```
